title.zh: AI 交出 700 多份手稿，数学家为何分歧如此之大？
title.en: AI released 700-plus manuscripts. Why are mathematicians divided?

description.zh: 10 月 6 日，OpenAI 公布内部模型生成的数学研究材料。有人把它看作科研加速的起点，有人呼吁停止合作。这两种反应，究竟在回答什么问题？
description.en: On October 6, OpenAI released mathematical research generated by an internal model. Some saw an acceleration of discovery; others called for a boycott. What lies behind these different responses?

title.zh: 聊了两小时的 Agent，为什么会忘记最初的要求？
title.en: Why can an agent forget a request from two hours ago?

description.zh: Pi 的两篇工程文章，拆开了长期对话中的两个问题：有限的工作记忆，以及反复读取历史的成本。
description.en: Two Pi engineering articles examine limited working context and the cost of repeatedly processing conversation history.

title.zh: Agent 做到一半断了，重启后能接着干吗？
title.en: Can an agent resume after crashing halfway through a task?

description.zh: Pi Durable 为长时间运行的 Agent 保存工作状态。难点出现在它已经影响了外部世界，却还没来得及留下完整记录的时候。
description.en: Pi Durable persists work for long-running agents. The difficult case arises when an external action has happened but its result has not yet been recorded.

title.zh: Dream-RSI：让 AI 从走过的弯路里，学会安排下一次实验
title.en: Dream-RSI: using past experiments to plan the next attempt

description.zh: 研究团队把代码优化的历史变成可重放的环境，再让 AI 改写探索策略。“做梦”省掉了什么，又没有省掉什么？
description.en: The researchers turn code-optimization history into a replay environment, then use AI to revise the search policy. What does this “dreaming” save?

title.zh: PANDA：一群 Agent，怎样组队才有意义？
title.en: PANDA: how should a group of agents form a useful team?

description.zh: 这篇论文把目光放在协作基础设施：找到合适的伙伴，按任务组织通信，并在成员失联时继续工作。
description.en: This paper studies collaboration infrastructure: finding suitable partners, organizing communication around a task and continuing when a participant fails.

title.zh: REA
title.en: REA

description.zh: 让编码 Agent 通过 MCP 检查应用行为与二进制，沿着证据理解一个功能怎样实现。
description.en: Connect a coding agent to application and binary inspection through MCP, tracing how a feature works.

title.zh: Designeer
title.en: Designeer

description.zh: 把设计工具、组件、学习资料与设计工程师放在一个可浏览的资源目录里。
description.en: A browsable directory of design tools, components, learning resources and design engineers.

title.zh: GitAgent
title.en: GitAgent

description.zh: 把 Agent 的身份、规则、记忆与技能写进 Git 仓库，用版本管理保留修改过程。
description.en: Keep an agent’s identity, rules, memory and skills in a Git repository, with versioned changes.

title.zh: Monid
title.en: Monid

description.zh: 让 Agent 从统一入口发现并调用工具，提供 Skill、MCP 与 CLI 接入方式。
description.en: A shared entry point for agents to discover and call tools through skills, MCP or a CLI.

title.zh: OpenBot
title.en: OpenBot

description.zh: 在桌面端给不同 Agent 配置指令和工作区，让它们交接任务、共享文件。
description.en: Give desktop agents separate instructions and workspaces, with task handoff and shared files.

title.zh: Rill
title.en: Rill

description.zh: 把浏览页面与 Claude Code、Codex 任务放在同一个窗口，减少页面和项目之间的切换。
description.en: Bring browsing and Claude Code or Codex tasks into one window, connecting pages with project work.

title.zh: Mintlify
title.en: Mintlify

description.zh: 让人和 Agent 都更方便地阅读、搜索与使用产品文档，连接文档和 API 工作流。
description.en: Help people and agents read, search and use product documentation alongside API workflows.

title.zh: Lapis One
title.en: Lapis One

description.zh: 给 Agent 一台独立的 Debian 电脑，并提供远程连接和控制其他设备的硬件入口。
description.en: A dedicated Debian computer for agents, with remote access and hardware connections to other devices.

title.zh: vPhone Workstation
title.en: vPhone Workstation

description.zh: 在原生 macOS 窗口中管理虚拟 iPhone，查看设备库、配置和启动状态。
description.en: Manage virtual iPhones in a native macOS window, with a device library, settings and lifecycle controls.

title.zh: T3 Code
title.en: T3 Code

description.zh: 把多个编程 Agent 的对话、代码差异与 Git 协作放进一个开源图形控制台。
description.en: An open-source graphical workspace for coding-agent threads, diffs and Git collaboration.

title.zh: 把反复犯的错，写成下一次会失败的检查
title.en: Turn recurring mistakes into failing checks

description.zh: /correct 讨论的是编程 Agent 反复犯同一种错时，怎样把纠正留下来：把约束写进 lint、类型检查或测试。下一次即使模型忘了口头提醒，执行检查仍会给出具体反馈。它把“记住教训”变成了工作环境的一部分，适合那些能清楚描述失败条件的错误。
description.en: The /correct proposal turns recurring coding mistakes into lint rules, type checks or tests. Even when an agent forgets a verbal correction, the environment can report the same concrete failure. This preserves feedback where the failure condition can be stated clearly.

title.zh: 文件名会变，项目约束仍要说清楚
title.en: Names change; project constraints still need clarity

description.zh: 这篇收藏讨论 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md 与 Agent 运行环境的定制。这类文件承担的是项目交接：告诉 Agent 怎样构建、怎样验收、哪些约束不能漏。真正有价值的内容是能让它开始工作的具体信息；文件名与加载方式则需要随所用工具一起确认。
description.en: This reading discusses CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and customization of the environment around an agent. These files serve as project handoffs: how to build, how to validate and which constraints matter. Useful instructions make work startable; filenames and loading behavior remain tool-specific.

title.zh: EmbeddingGemma 2：让不同模态进入同一检索空间
title.en: EmbeddingGemma 2: one retrieval space across modalities

description.zh: Google 的模型卡确认文本、图像、视频与音频可以映射到同一 768 维空间，并允许按需加载编码器。它值得从一个自己的资料库任务试起：用文字找到相关图片或录音。先评估召回结果与设备负担，再判断是否适合长期使用。
description.en: Google’s model card describes text, image, video and audio embeddings in a shared 768-dimensional space, with selectively loaded encoders. Try a personal-library task, such as finding an image or recording from text, then evaluate retrieval and device overhead.

title.zh: Jev 的应用目录又长了一点
title.en: The Jev application list keeps growing

description.zh: 本条收藏记录 awesome-jev 从 583 到 591 条的巡检，新增方向涉及 bisect、审核与安全扫描。这里更值得逐项看的是：决策层在哪里接入、判断之后由谁执行。目录规模是原帖的时点记录，不代表每个项目都已经成熟。
description.en: The saved inspection note records awesome-jev growing from 583 to 591 entries, including bisect, moderation and security work. Examine where each decision layer connects and what executes afterward. The count is a snapshot, not a maturity rating.

title.zh: DEX #366：个人 Agent 需要怎样的电脑
title.en: DEX #366: what computer does a personal agent need?

description.zh: DEX 把个人 Agent、云端电脑和 AI 电脑放在一起，很适合比较任务住在哪里：随身设备、常驻主机，还是临时云桌面。选择环境时，先想任务是否要持续运行、要访问什么资料、故障后怎样接手；再看硬件和服务。
description.en: DEX groups personal agents, cloud desktops and AI computers. Compare where a task lives: a portable device, an always-on host or a temporary cloud desktop. Start with persistence, data access and recovery needs before choosing hardware or services.

title.zh: 16 款产品，反复出现的是记忆与主动性
title.en: Across 16 products, memory and initiative recur

description.zh: Founder Park 的产品合集覆盖 Personal Agent、垂直助手和记忆工具。适合当一张候选清单来浏览，先选与你眼下任务相邻的一款。主动提醒能否帮忙，要看它记住了什么、何时打断你，以及能否让你检查和修正。
description.en: Founder Park’s roundup spans personal agents, specialist assistants and memory tools. Use it as a candidate list and try one adjacent to a current task. Useful initiative depends on what a tool remembers, when it interrupts and whether you can inspect and correct it.

title.zh: Thin Is In：界面变薄以后，控制留在哪里
title.en: Thin Is In: where does control live in a thinner interface?

description.zh: 《Thin Is In》把持续存在的 Agent 与更轻的交互界面联系起来。过去需要打开应用、点击多个入口的工作，可能收敛为一句委托。由此产生的新设计题是：操作入口少了，任务进度、所用材料和用户接管的位置，应该怎样保留下来？
description.en: Thin Is In connects persistent agents with lighter interfaces. Work that once required opening an app and navigating several controls may begin with a short request. That creates a design question: where do progress, source material and opportunities to take over remain visible?

title.zh: AIGC Weekly #191：本期只读到公开节选
title.en: AIGC Weekly #191: a partial reading

description.zh: 已缓存的公开部分涉及 Personal Agent、AI 反编译与跨设备工作。阅读流标注目前只收到了约 21% 内容，因此这里只保留这份节选的线索，不把它写成完整一期的结论；想读全篇，可以回到原订阅渠道。
description.en: The cached portion covers personal agents, AI decompilation and cross-device work. The stream reports roughly 21% coverage, so this note retains the excerpt’s threads without presenting a verdict on the entire newsletter. The full issue belongs in its subscription channel.

title.zh: AI 越来越常用，是否就说明投入越来越值得？
title.en: Does more AI usage mean better value?

description.zh: 卡兹克对照 A16Z 的两份报告，观察 AI 的使用频率、付费与消费集中。它提供了从“模型又强了多少”转向“人们怎样使用 AI”的视角。读这类数据时，我会把使用者、付费者与整体人群分开：付费增长说明需求，却还需要任务完成、节省时间和持续使用的数据，才能解释用户获得了什么价值。
description.en: Kazike compares two A16Z reports on usage frequency, payment and concentration of spending. The useful shift is from model capability to how people use AI. Users, paying users and the general population are different denominators. Spending indicates demand; completed tasks, time saved and continued use help explain the value delivered.

title.zh: 手指的间隙：一个看得见的芝诺悖论
title.en: The gap between fingers: seeing Zeno’s paradox

description.zh: 原帖把指缝不断对半的过程拍给孩子看。它提醒我，解释一个概念不一定先搬出复杂符号。下面是编者自己的等比图解：无穷多个剩余步骤，也可能有有限的总和；‘步骤无穷’本身，并不能推出‘时间无穷’。
description.en: The original post shows a child a finger gap repeatedly halving. Explanation need not begin with complicated notation. Our geometric-series sketch below makes one point: infinitely many remaining steps can have a finite sum; infinitely many steps alone do not imply infinite time.

title.zh: 《动手学大语言模型》：把图解当成学习路径
title.en: Hands-On Large Language Models: learn through diagrams

description.zh: Jay Alammar 与 Maarten Grootendorst 的《动手学大语言模型》，用图解和代码连接模型原理与实际应用。它适合补齐本期工程专题背后的基础：文本怎样变成 token，向量怎样支持检索，一次生成怎样接着已有输入继续。把机制看明白，再回头读产品宣称，更容易判断变化发生在哪一层。
description.en: Jay Alammar and Maarten Grootendorst’s Hands-On Large Language Models connects model concepts to applications through illustrations and code. It provides useful background for this issue: tokens, vector retrieval and generation conditioned on earlier input. Understanding the mechanism makes it easier to locate what a product claim actually changes.

description.zh: OpenAI 公布 700 多份 AI 数学手稿，随后出现修订、撤回与抵制。从事件经过读起，看 AI 的贡献、数学家的分歧，以及新的合作方式。
description.en: OpenAI released 700-plus AI mathematics manuscripts. Explore the research, corrections and objections, and how people and AI might collaborate.

title.zh: AI 与数学
title.en: AI and mathematics

description.zh: 突破、抵制与新的科研分工
description.en: Breakthroughs, resistance and research roles

title.zh: Agent 怎样承担工作
title.en: Agents taking on work

description.zh: 记忆的取舍与行动的责任
description.en: Memory choices and responsibility for actions

title.zh: AI 究竟在改进什么
title.en: What is AI improving?

description.zh: 自我改进与协作的边界
description.en: The limits of improvement and collaboration

title.zh: 本周新品架
title.en: This week’s shelf

description.zh: 10 款产品，快速认识
description.en: A quick look at ten products

title.zh: 一周的其他线索
title.en: Other threads

description.zh: 产品观察、阅读与图解
description.en: Products, reading and visual thinking

title.zh: Opus 5.5，把代码拍成电影
title.en: Opus 5.5: making films with code

description.zh: 这不是把一句提示词交给视频模型，而是让 Opus 写动画、浏览器画帧、剪辑工具合成。它真正改变的，是影片可以怎样修改。
description.en: Opus writes animation, a browser renders frames, and editing tools assemble the film. The interesting change is how precisely a film can be revised.

title.zh: 集邮册动效：把一个动作做完整
title.en: Stamp-book motion: finish one small gesture

description.zh: 翻页、落章、再翻页。这个案例的价值在动作之间的节奏与材质衔接，适合当作 UI 和品牌动效的观察样本，不必套一个宏大的 AI 结论。
description.en: Page turn, stamp, next page. Study the rhythm and material transitions as UI or brand-motion inspiration; the example does not need a grand AI thesis.

title.zh: 15 秒艺术史：看表达，也看压缩的代价
title.en: Art history in 15 seconds: expression and compression

description.zh: 作者展示 Fable 5.5 的艺术史动画，适合观察视觉过渡和风格连贯性。把四万年压进十几秒，是创意概括；历史准确性、制作耗时与可复现程度不能仅从成片推断。
description.en: The creator’s Fable 5.5 clip offers visual transitions and stylistic continuity to study. Condensing history is a creative interpretation; a clip alone cannot establish historical accuracy, production time or reproducibility.

title.zh: 技术变快，创意的判断仍要留下
title.en: Faster technology still needs creative judgment

description.zh: Katzenberg 的观点把讨论拉回想象力、情感和创作者报酬。和封面专题一起看，值得问的是：当出片更容易，故事、选择与合作条款能不能同步变好？
description.en: Katzenberg brings the discussion back to imagination, emotion and compensation for creators. Alongside the cover story, ask whether easier production also improves storytelling, choices and collaboration terms.

title.zh: 上下文瘦了，证据不能丢
title.en: Less context, with evidence intact

description.zh: Pi 把档案与工作台分开，SoL-Pi 再压缩重复信息。但一张更便宜的账单，可能也对应更少的成功任务。
description.en: Pi separates the archive from the working context; SoL-Pi reduces repetition. A smaller bill can also come with fewer solved tasks.

title.zh: Pi Agent 1.0：极简助手，长任务新路
title.en: Pi Agent 1.0: two paths for agent work

description.zh: Pi 1.0 延续终端里的极简交互，实验性的 Pi Durable 探索长任务恢复。沿着这次发布，看 Agent 怎样兼顾轻与稳。
description.en: Pi 1.0 refines the minimal terminal agent; the experimental Pi Durable explores long-running work. The release brings both choices into focus.

title.zh: Claude Mods，让工作台长出自己的工具
title.en: Claude Mods: tools that fit your workflow

description.zh: 从观察上下文到插入提醒，终端里的 Agent 正在变成可以定制的工作环境。
description.en: From context displays to timely reminders, the terminal agent is becoming a customizable work environment.

title.zh: 从写代码，走到负责运行
title.en: From writing code to operating systems

description.zh: 腾讯云 SRE 实践把基础设施、可观测数据和知识建成关联图谱，并把能力分成只读诊断、授权建议与自动执行。值得借鉴的是渐进放权：先证明能解释故障，再让它参与改变系统。
description.en: The Tencent Cloud SRE case connects infrastructure, observations and knowledge in a graph, and stages capability from read-only diagnosis to approved recommendations and execution. The lesson is gradual delegation: demonstrate explanations before permitting operational changes.

title.zh: 先定义分工，再组 Agent 团队
title.en: Define the work before assembling an agent team

description.zh: 这条 Opus 团队案例可以作为搭建入口。真正需要先决定的是角色边界、交接产物与验收条件；任务能够独立验证，团队协作才不会只增加对话。
description.en: The Opus team example is a starting point. Decide role boundaries, handoff artifacts and acceptance checks first; independently verifiable work keeps collaboration from merely adding conversation.

title.zh: Jev 怎么分工，才是真的省？
title.en: When does Jev routing actually save money?

description.zh: Jev 的五条收藏都在讨论分工：分类、打分与选择，是否每次都需要完整的生成式推理？
description.en: Five Jev saves explore division of labor: do classification, scoring and routing always require full generative reasoning?

title.zh: 90.5% 与约五分之一成本：评测怎样把钱省对
title.en: 90.5% at about a fifth of the cost: an eval case

description.zh: 一个 44 条支持工单的案例，展示了为什么“分数更高”必须说清在哪组样本上，以及 Agent 到底改了什么。
description.en: A 44-ticket support case shows why a higher score needs a named dataset—and an account of what the agent changed.

title.zh: 关键节点叫一次顾问
title.en: Bring in an advisor at decision points

description.zh: 主模型负责执行，顾问在计划前、反复失败时或完成前检查盲点。这是社区提供的使用思路；配置名称和模型可用性应以当前工具文档为准，不必让每一步都经过双模型。
description.en: Use the main model for execution and an advisor before a plan, after repeated failures or before completion. This is a community workflow idea; confirm current configuration and model availability rather than using two models for every step.

title.zh: ElevenLabs
title.en: ElevenLabs

description.zh: 把旁白、配音与对话式语音能力集中在一个云端平台。
description.en: A hosted platform for narration, dubbing and conversational voice.

title.zh: VoiceStudio
title.en: VoiceStudio

description.zh: 社区推荐的本地语音工具，覆盖克隆、合成与配音。
description.en: A community-recommended local tool for cloning, synthesis and dubbing.

title.zh: drawgent
title.en: drawgent

description.zh: 把编码 Agent 接到 Excalidraw，可读取并修改同一张图。
description.en: Connect coding agents to a shared Excalidraw canvas.

title.zh: Chit
title.en: Chit

description.zh: 把本地 Claude Code 工作历史整理成按项目分组的小票。
description.en: Turn local Claude Code history into project-based receipts.

title.zh: Hemory
title.en: Hemory

description.zh: 把日常语音转成可检索的记忆，再提供给 Agent 使用。
description.en: Convert everyday speech into searchable memory for agents.

title.zh: NOAN
title.en: NOAN

description.zh: 给业务 Agent 准备统一的事实与上下文。
description.en: A shared source of business facts and context for agents.

title.zh: Rene
title.en: Rene

description.zh: 把个人助理延伸到移动端与多人协作场景。
description.en: A personal assistant spanning mobile and shared workflows.

title.zh: Invent a Dataset
title.en: Invent a Dataset

description.zh: 从任务意图出发生成特定用途的训练数据。
description.en: Generate task-specific training data from an intent.

title.zh: Maestro
title.en: Maestro

description.zh: 用可读流程描述移动端与 Web 的界面测试。
description.en: Describe mobile and web UI tests with readable flows.

title.zh: e2e · TesterArmy
title.en: e2e · TesterArmy

description.zh: 将确定性定位与 AI 操作步骤放在同一套测试里。
description.en: Combine deterministic locators and AI steps in one test.

title.zh: Sonnet 5.5：日常任务的效率竞争
title.en: Sonnet 5.5: efficiency for everyday work

description.zh: 官方发布强调速度与效率的提升。这条收藏更值得关注的是任务分层：日常修复、文档与边界清楚的工作，可以重新比较不同模型的成本和结果；不要把某项基准持平等同于所有工作都能替代。
description.en: The official launch emphasizes speed and efficiency. Revisit model choice for bounded tasks such as fixes and documents; similar benchmark scores do not mean interchangeable performance on every workload.

title.zh: DevDay 与 Jev：决策能力开始成为平台接口
title.en: DevDay and Jev: decisions as a platform capability

description.zh: 两篇收藏分别总结 DevDay 和讨论 Decisions API 对 Jev 的竞争。它们指向决策层平台化，但“杀死竞品”仍是原作者的判断。评估时应比较可用范围、结构化输出、延迟、成本与迁移代价，而不是只比较发布声量。
description.en: The two saves summarize DevDay and debate the Decisions API’s impact on Jev. They point toward decisions becoming a platform capability; “killing” a competitor is the author’s interpretation. Compare availability, output guarantees, latency, cost and switching overhead.

title.zh: DEX #365：动效普及后，什么还稀缺？
title.en: DEX #365: what remains scarce when motion is easy?

description.zh: 这份邮件周刊把动效普及与 Personal Agent 放在一起观察：制作门槛下降，并不自动产生好作品；个人 Agent 也需要资源与交互体验支撑。它为封面补了一层判断。阅读流保留了邮件全文，原邮件没有公开 URL。
description.en: This email issue connects ubiquitous motion design with personal agents: lower production barriers do not automatically produce good work, and assistants still need resources and good interactions. It adds an editorial counterpoint to the cover. The saved email has no public original URL.

title.zh: AIGC #190：一份生态观察
title.en: AIGC #190: an ecosystem snapshot

description.zh: 阅读流里保存的可见部分讨论 Opus、Muse 与创作案例。本期只据这部分做索引，不把未保存的付费内容当作已读来源。它与 DEX 形成对照：一个聚焦上新与案例，一个追问体验与作品质量。
description.en: The accessible saved portion discusses Opus, Muse and creative examples. This issue indexes only that portion and does not treat the uncaptured paid remainder as read. Alongside DEX, it contrasts new releases with questions about experience and quality.

title.zh: 私人助理，究竟替用户省什么？
title.en: What does a personal assistant actually save?

description.zh: “没人真想要 AI 私人助理”是一条鲜明的观点，不是需求统计。它提出的提醒很有用：用户想少操心，未必想交出决定权。产品应该先找到具体的重复任务，并把建议、授权和执行分开，而不是先许诺接管人生。
description.en: “Nobody wants an AI assistant” is a provocative opinion, not demand data. The useful question is whether users want less mental effort without surrendering decisions. Start with specific repeated tasks and separate recommendations, approvals and execution.

title.zh: 创作之后，还要考虑作品怎么被找到
title.en: After creation, think about discovery

description.zh: 这条小红书获客经验是本期的边界素材：它不直接讲 AI，却提醒内容生产还有分发与转化。保留为短读，不上升为平台规律；发布时间、账号策略和流量结论都是作者的经验，不能保证复现。
description.en: This Xiaohongshu marketing save sits at the edge of the AI theme: production also needs discovery and conversion. It remains a short reading note. Timing, account strategy and traffic outcomes are the author’s experience, not guaranteed platform rules.

title.zh: “封杀 AI”标题下，实际是政府术语变更
title.en: Behind the “AI ban” headline: terminology

description.zh: 核对行政命令原文后，变化是行政部门在适用的官方表述中使用 SI 代替 AI；既有历史文件无需全部修改。该命令本身并没有宣布禁用 AI 技术。涉及政策新闻时，先分清名称、法律定义与实质措施，才能判断实际影响。
description.en: The executive order concerns using SI instead of AI in applicable executive-branch communications; existing historical documents need not all be revised. The order does not itself ban the technology. Separate terminology, legal definitions and substantive measures before assessing impact.

description.zh: 从代码生成影片，到更省上下文的 Agent 运行方式，本期追踪的是：更快、更便宜的能力，怎样变成可控的工作流。
description.en: From films built with code to leaner agents: how do faster, cheaper tools become workflows we can control?

title.en: Changes to watch

description.en: Launches, opinions and ecosystem

title.zh: Jev 不写长回答，怎样做出一个判断？
title.en: No long answer. How does Jev make a decision?

description.zh: 理解它要分清四件事：预先约束的答案空间、并行判断、概率校准，以及最终仍由程序承担的业务规则。
description.en: Four distinctions matter: a predefined answer space, parallel decisions, probability calibration, and business rules that remain the program’s responsibility.

title.zh: Pi × Jev：把执行权写回代码
title.en: Pi × Jev：Putting execution authority back into code

description.zh: 路由、工具闸门、答案复核各自回答一个小问题，模型负责给出信号，Harness 负责决定后果。
description.en: Routing, tool gates and answer verification each address a small question. The model supplies signals; the harness decides the consequences.

title.zh: Jev 与 FLock，先把测量条件对齐
title.en: Jev and FLock: align the measurement conditions first

description.zh: 一千条金融投诉的社区试验提出了好问题；模型版本、长文分布、网络时间和成本口径，决定结果能迁移到哪里。
description.en: A community test of a thousand financial complaints raises useful questions. Model versions, the distribution of long inputs, network time and cost definitions determine where its conclusions can apply.

title.zh: Jev 的局限，怎样变成工作流设计
title.en: Jev’s limitations: turning them into workflow design

description.zh: 并行能力只有放进合适的任务结构才会兑现。字幕筛选、日期提取与中文评测，分别展示了语义判断、确定性计算和质量验证的边界。
description.en: Parallelism pays off only when the task structure suits it. Subtitle selection, date extraction and Chinese-language evaluation reveal the respective boundaries of semantic judgment, deterministic computation and quality assurance.

title.zh: 四类 Jev 应用，判断怎样进入真实流程
title.en: Four kinds of Jev applications: decisions in real workflows

description.zh: 浏览器、文档、广告与销售演示已经给出不同的接入方法；公开代码比演示速度更能说明 Jev 究竟承担了哪一步。
description.en: Browser, document, advertising and sales demos show different integration patterns. Public code reveals more than demo speed about exactly which step Jev performs.

title.zh: 腾讯排错 Agent：修复建议要带着证据
title.en: Tencent’s debugging agent: recommendations need evidence

description.zh: 从小时级到分钟级，压缩的是跨系统拼证据的过程。88% 的动作一致率，要连同样本用途和置信度规则一起读。
description.en: Moving from hours to minutes compresses the work of assembling evidence across systems. Read the 88% action-agreement rate alongside the sample’s purpose and its confidence rules.

title.zh: Grok 一人公司的账，要把审稿和失败算进去
title.en: A one-person Grok business: count review time and failures

description.zh: $18K 是五个客户的营收目标，原文未展示实收记录。能借鉴的是路由与验收设计，落地还需要完整成本账和异常出口。
description.en: $18K is a revenue target for five clients; the article does not show payment records. Its routing and acceptance design is useful, but operating it requires complete cost accounting and a way to handle exceptions.

title.zh: 把角色做成动画，还要能接着改
title.en: Animate the character. Keep the ability to edit it.

description.zh: Rege 的案例值得收藏的部分，是随演示提供的 .coa 工程。拆开文件，能看见表情、头发运动与时间控制如何成为独立的修改入口。
description.en: What makes Rege’s example worth saving is the .coa project supplied with the demo. Inside it, expressions, hair movement and timing become separate places to make changes.

title.zh: 五分钟像素动画，“做出来”之后看什么
title.en: A pixel animation in five minutes: what comes after the first result?

description.zh: Rikuo 的短片提供了鲜明的风格样本。把它变成自己的制作能力，需要把画面规格、可编辑交付和返工测试一起设计。
description.en: Rikuo’s short clip is a distinctive style reference. Turning it into your own production capability requires visual specifications, editable deliverables and revision tests together.

title.zh: 463 条视频案例，怎样成为可复用的流程
title.en: 463 video examples: turning them into reusable workflows

description.zh: 真正可带走的是人物约束、分镜结构和失败记录。原帖、收藏日仓库与当前仓库的数字并不相同，应把版本和计数对象写清楚。
description.en: The reusable assets are character constraints, storyboard structure and failure records. The post, the repository on the save date and the current repository have different counts. Versions and counting units need to be explicit.

title.zh: Fish Audio：语音可控，控在哪里？
title.en: Fish Audio：What can you actually control in a voice?

description.zh: Fish Audio 的情绪标签让脚本能说明“怎么读”。完整的声音工作流仍要处理参考音色、专名读音、段落衔接和反复生成的成本。
description.en: Fish Audio’s emotion tags let scripts specify how a line is read. A complete voice workflow still needs reference voices, pronunciation of names, transitions between passages and accounting for repeated generations.

title.zh: ScreenKite：对话剪辑怎样接管时间轴
title.en: ScreenKite：How conversational editing meets the timeline

description.zh: 录屏、转写、剪辑和 B-roll 连在一起，价值在于每一次指令都有可检查的片段与时间范围。模型费用、素材上传和可编辑导出仍要分别看。
description.en: Recording, transcription, editing and B-roll become useful together when every instruction maps to inspectable clips and time ranges. Model costs, asset uploads and editable exports still require separate scrutiny.

title.zh: Claude 找到 ART，新的到底是什么？
title.en: Claude found ART. What is actually new?

description.zh: AGI Hunt 的报道提供了一条比模型“兴奋”更值得追的线索：把已知酶、邻近基因与一排 RNA 联系起来，究竟推进了多少生物学认识？
description.en: AGI Hunt’s report offers a lead more interesting than a model expressing excitement: how much biological understanding advances when a known enzyme, neighboring genes and repeated RNA elements are connected?

title.zh: 21 小时之后，Claude 科研如何复查
title.en: After 21 hours: how to review Claude’s research

description.zh: 新智元的“950 个 Agent”适合做标题。理解这项工作的实际进展，还要把会话数、候选数、报告数和实验结果放回各自的位置。
description.en: AI Era’s 950 agents makes a striking headline. Understanding the actual progress requires separating session counts, candidate counts, report counts and experimental results.

title.zh: 一线 QA 的价值：知道哪些地方会出问题
title.en: The value of frontline QA: knowing where things break

description.zh: 一篇内网帖的转述不能证明企业的人事决策，却提出了具体问题：自动化越便宜，谁来定义值得测试的真实风险？
description.en: A secondhand account of an internal post cannot establish a company’s staffing decisions, but it raises a concrete question: as automation gets cheaper, who defines the real risks worth testing?

title.zh: 四个日常小产品，四种具体的生活阻力
title.en: Four small products, four everyday obstacles

description.zh: 同样围绕时间与行动，儿童的剩余时间、成人的分心、户外探索和习惯重启，需要各自成立的交互机制。
description.en: Children’s sense of remaining time, adults’ distraction, outdoor exploration and restarting habits all concern time and action, but each needs its own interaction mechanism.

description.en: Inside Jev’s decisions, the next steps in AI creation, Claude’s biology research, and products for everyday life.
